title: perilla frutescens var. typica
intro: Perilla frutescens var. typica, commonly known as Shiso or Japanese basil, is a plant species native to East Asia, belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Perilla frutescens var. typica include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and neuroprotective effects, which contribute to its use in treating conditions such as anxiety, stress, and cognitive decline. The bioactive constituents of this plant include perillaldehyde, perillene, and beta-caryophyllene, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
